places.name: Red River
places.note: Blue Duck crossed it and went straight north; Augustus tells Roscoe that getting back south of it means relative safety.

places.name: Augustus's buffalo wallow
places.note: Ambushed on open prairie, Augustus kills his horse for cover in a shallow wallow amid bones and shoots six attackers before a buffalo-gun sniper pins him.
places.location_hint: level plain about ten miles south of the Canadian River, Texas Panhandle, a morning's ride east of Aus Frank's bone camp

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: The party rides to the steep-banked river, spots a campfire downstream, camps upriver at a canyon mouth, and Augustus and July ride toward the fire.

places.name: July's canyon-mouth camp on the Canadian
places.note: Where a canyon slopes into the riverbed; Roscoe and the youngsters are left here while the two men ride off.
places.location_hint: on the Canadian River, Texas Panhandle, about a mile upriver from where they first struck it and some seven or eight miles west of the outlaws' campfire

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July introduces himself as its sheriff; violent death is uncommon there, Roscoe reflects.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July admits robbers are the worst trouble there, so he has never killed anyone.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus jokes the outfit expected July to show up there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Augustus says they are nearly in it.

groups.label: Augustus and July
groups.hint: within a mile of the outlaws' campfire on the Canadian, about a hundred yards from the river, preparing to charge

groups.label: July's companions
groups.at: July's canyon-mouth camp on the Canadian
groups.hint: waiting at a canyon mouth on the Canadian, several miles upriver from the outlaw camp
